content.area.keep.name: 石垒要塞
content.class.warden.blurb: 铁剑与锁甲——为前排冲锋而生。
content.class.warden.name: 卫士
content.dlg.keeper.greet.opt.0.label: 你是谁？
content.dlg.keeper.greet.opt.1.label: 我会肃清这座要塞。
content.dlg.keeper.greet.text: 你来了。很好。荒原在大厅里唤起了一名哨卫——把它放倒，取走它守着的钥匙，再解开内门的门闩。神龛就在门后。
content.dlg.keeper.lore.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.keeper.lore.text: 丢了这地方的队长。我仍守着这道门，因为我离不开它。做得比我当年好些。
content.npc.keeper.name: 守关人
content.obj.trial.door.hint: 上闩的门立在角落的房间里；用旧钥匙打开它。
content.obj.trial.door.title: 解开内门的门闩
content.obj.trial.key.hint: 钥匙就在大厅旁小室的箱子里。
content.obj.trial.key.title: 取得旧钥
content.obj.trial.shrine.hint: 穿过开启的石门，踏上大厅尽头的神龛。
content.obj.trial.shrine.title: 抵达神龛
content.obj.trial.slay.hint: 守关人话音未落，哨卫便自四周站起——将它们尽数斩除。
content.obj.trial.slay.title: 扫清哨卫
content.quest.greet.goal: 接下守关人的托付，惊动哨卫。
content.quest.trial.goal: 扫清哨卫，取得钥匙，打开石门，抵达神龛。
content.wave.guards.mob.0.name: 要塞哨卫
content.world.title: 要塞的试炼

source.area.keep.name: The Stone Keep
source.class.warden.blurb: Iron sword and mail — made for the front rank.
source.class.warden.name: Warden
source.dlg.keeper.greet.opt.0.label: Who are you?
source.dlg.keeper.greet.opt.1.label: I'll clear the keep.
source.dlg.keeper.greet.text: You came. Good. The moor raised a guard in the hall — put it down, take the key it kept, and unbar the inner door. The shrine lies past it.
source.dlg.keeper.lore.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.keeper.lore.text: The captain who lost this place. I hold the gate still, because I cannot leave it. Do better than I did.
source.npc.keeper.name: The Keeper
source.obj.trial.door.hint: The barred door stands in the corner room; use the old key on it.
source.obj.trial.door.title: Unbar the Inner Door
source.obj.trial.key.hint: The key sits in a chest in the small room off the hall.
source.obj.trial.key.title: Take the Old Key
source.obj.trial.shrine.hint: Pass the opened gate and step onto the shrine at the hall's end.
source.obj.trial.shrine.title: Reach the Shrine
source.obj.trial.slay.hint: The guard rises around you as the Keeper speaks — cut every one of them down.
source.obj.trial.slay.title: Clear the Guard
source.quest.greet.goal: Take the Keeper's charge and raise the guard.
source.quest.trial.goal: Clear the guard, take the key, open the door, reach the shrine.
source.wave.guards.mob.0.name: Keep Guard
source.world.title: Trial of the Keep
